verdict.rationale: Insomnia's import docs list OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 and Swagger as supported import formats. They also document a UI import flow (File/Clipboard/URL) for bringing an OpenAPI spec into Insomnia, which covers the core of the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation that importing a spec generates individual requests and organizes them into collections (this is only implied), details on how spec operations map to requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can import an OpenAPI spec to generate requests and collections
